headline: Columbia Banking System Tops Q3 Estimates as Net Interest Income Jumps 22%
summary: Columbia Banking System posted third-quarter earnings that surpassed analyst estimates, bolstered by a 22% year-over-year increase in net interest income.
why: Regional bank earnings reflect lending margins, funding costs, and credit quality across U.S. regional economies.

impacts.name: Columbia Banking System, Inc.
impacts.why: A 22% surge in net interest income led to an earnings beat against analyst expectations.
